unit_note: These are CHARACTER budgets, not token counts. No tokenizer ships with this repository, so character counts are used as a stable, honest proxy. Do not present a character count as a token count. If a real tokenizer is available in your environment, measure tokens with it and report that number as the token count.

enforcement.policy: A budget overrun is a signal to move detail into references/, never a reason to make a safety, honesty, or permission rule vague or unreadable.
